title: GitHub Copilot
before: Code completion used static analysis of the current file and project.
problem: Nobody had shipped a large language model into a daily professional workflow.
breakthrough: Codex behind an editor plugin, suggesting whole functions from a comment or signature.
why: The first mass-market LLM product, eighteen months before ChatGPT, and the start of AI coding as a category.
next: Chat interfaces, then agentic coding tools that edit repositories directly.
inherits: AI assistance as a normal part of writing software.
